scope_note: This identifies Beck's named therapy and does not equate it with every later CBT approach.
statement: Beck and Fleming report that Aaron Beck named his new approach Cognitive Therapy after shifting the therapeutic setting and focus toward examining automatic thoughts.
statement_zh: Beck 與 Fleming 記述，Aaron Beck 將治療情境與焦點轉向檢視自動思考後，把新方法命名為「認知治療」。
